title: Map tokens at their real size
summary: Tokens on gridded maps are now drawn at their creature size and snap to the square you drop them on.
items: Tokens are round portraits or initials that fill their footprint, with the name below: Tiny takes a quarter square, Small and Medium one square, Large 2×2, Huge 3×3 and Gargantuan 4×4.
DMs set a token's size in the Inspector, or Custom squares up to 8×8. Wider tokens are placed by their top-left square.
Creatures from the SRD keep their stat-block size when an encounter roster is placed on a map.
With snapping on, a dragged token lands on the square under the point you grabbed, so a Large token doesn't jump under your finger, and its whole footprint stays on the grid.
While dragging, a label shows the squares the token will cover and how far it moves.
Moves that aren't snapped or leave the grid are refused rather than moved somewhere else.
Older apps keep working: they see sized tokens at their centre and are asked to update before moving a Large or Gargantuan token on a snapped map.
